author: Joltz_
body:
I decided to make a new team. Anyone can join, but it'd be nice if you lived around the NZ/AUS area!

'Why don't we call our team "Freedom"?'
'But then it sounds like we're "Free DUMB" and we totally are not!'
'Yeah! Totally! We're so super duper smart!'
'Then it's settled, We're "FreeSmart!"!

Our team has no application. We just accept anyone so please. Feel free to reply and we may look into you.
